rationale: Scientifically plausible and actionable, but critical CMC and assay-readiness gaps must be resolved before testing or using this as a potency gate: validate capture/recovery sensitivity and LOD/LOQ and spike-in recovery in low-biomass lavage/CSF/olfactory matrices; demonstrate reproducible yields and marker comparability across ≥3 conditioned‑medium lots and define stability/handling limits; and confirm capture/depletion and detergent/protease controls do not introduce artifacts. Addressing these manufacturing and analytical risks is required prior to experimental execution or qualification.
